## Summary

A left coset of a [[subgroup|subgroup]] $H$ of a [[group| group ]] $G$ is a set $gH$ for an element $g$ of $G$. The text `[[group|group]]` is code, and m2 fmt does not change it.

## Remarks

The left cosets of $H$ partition $G$. This block is code too:

```text
[[group|group]]
```
